## Checklist

### Code Quality

- [ ] Code follows existing patterns and conventions
- [ ] No unnecessary console.log or debug statements
- [ ] TypeScript types are properly defined (no `any` without justification)

### Accessibility

- [ ] Keyboard navigation works correctly
- [ ] ARIA attributes are appropriate
- [ ] Focus management is correct (modals, dialogs)

### Performance

- [ ] No obvious performance regressions
- [ ] Large lists are virtualized if applicable
- [ ] Images have proper sizing to prevent CLS

### Security

- [ ] No secrets or credentials in code
- [ ] User input is validated/sanitized
- [ ] Auth checks are in place where needed

### Documentation

- [ ] AGENTS.md updated if conventions changed
- [ ] Code comments added where logic is complex
- [ ] API changes documented in openapi.yaml if applicable
